title: Prescriptions Desk System Card: Relabel Remake for Wrong Directions on the Label
content:
When a dispensing-error report on a Kestrel Prescriptions record is of the type wrong directions on the label — a mislabeled-directions report — and its review outcome is confirmed, correctly labelled medication is dispensed at no charge as a corrected remake. The units handed out on it are the relabel remake quantity.

## Governing rule

- The relabel remake answers a confirmed wrong-directions-label dispensing-error report.
- It refines the dispensing-error remake of Prescriptions and changes none of its conditions: the report must be confirmed, the remake is dispensed at no charge, consumes no refill and is not subject to the refill-eligible date.
- The remake is booked on the prescription's fill ledger as a corrected remake against the confirmed report it answers.

## Capability of the tool

`dispense_label_error_remake_88d3ae78` dispenses, at no charge, correctly labelled medication that answers a confirmed wrong-directions-label dispensing-error report, and books it on the prescription's fill ledger as a corrected remake. One call books one remake entry against the prescription and the fill that the report names. It records the units handed out under the corrected label, a patient pay of 0.00, today's date as the dispensing and ready date, and the store holding the prescription. No refill is consumed and the refill-eligible date is not touched. After the call the remake appears among the prescription's fill entries, linked to the report it answers, and is ready for pickup today.

## How it is invoked

The tool belongs to the agent. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `dispense_label_error_remake_88d3ae78`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `error_report_id` | the reference number of the confirmed dispensing-error report the remake answers, as returned by the dispensing-error report lookup for the prescription | text identifier |
| `quantity_dispensed` | the number of correctly labelled units dispensed on the remake | an integer count of dosage units (whole tablets or capsules), no decimals |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary: the remake's reference (text, the new fill-ledger reference of the remake), `error_report_id` (text, the report it answers), `prescription_id` (text, the prescription it is booked on), `quantity_dispensed` (integer dosage units handed out), `patient_pay_usd` (number, always 0.0), `ready_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `status` (text, "relabel_remake_booked" when the entry was written).
